"Lick It Up" is a song by the American rock band Kiss.
The title track to the group's 1983 album of the same name, it was released as the album's first single.
Musicians Paul Stanley and Vinnie Vincent composed the song.
Lick It Up is the eleventh studio album by American rock band Kiss.
Before its 1983 release, the band members appeared on MTV without their trademark make-up.
It was the first public appearance without make-up by the band, and their first for Mercury Records, where they had been signed following their departure from Casablanca Records.
